APPROVE
The diff alone indicates `BuildPlan` drops to about 6 (foreach +1, nested if +2, else-if +1, two `&&` sequences +2), the behaviour is unchanged because the `null` result from `TryGetApplyOrder` fails the positional `var (…)` pattern just as the old `continue` skipped the method, and nothing in it should break the build, though I only reviewed the diff and did not compile it or run any analyzers (e.g. one that flags a field placed after methods).
